Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: detailed pixel-art fighting game animation sprite sheet.
Reference image 1: the approved character identity and rendering style, NOT the pose sequence to copy. Preserve EXACTLY the reference person's face, head size, body build, hair, clothing, accessories and palette. Identity: Blue sleeveless ninja tunic, navy pants, burgundy red scarf and waist sash, black spiky hair, tiny silver forehead plate, white wrist and calf wraps, dark fingerless gloves and open-toe ninja sandals. NOT a white-gi karate fighter.
Primary request: Draw ONE 16-frame seamless cycle of calm, steady, slow guarded forward walking. Every cell is a different carefully drawn adjacent IN-BETWEEN in ONE continuous movement. No repeated four-pose rows. Delicate ankle rotation, toe flexion, knee weight absorption, small opposite hip/shoulder rotation, low relaxed elbows. At least one full support foot stays firmly on the floor in every frame. No running, marching, bouncing, high knee lifts, airborne hops, crouching or attacks. Feet never cross and guard always faces RIGHT.
Animation sequence in strict reading order: Advance toward the RIGHT while facing RIGHT: lead/right-side foot moves FIRST, rear/left-side foot follows. Frames 0-3: balanced guard, shift onto rear leg, gently peel lead heel up, lead foot makes a LOW short reach. Frames 4-7: lead heel contacts, sole rolls flat, weight settles onto lead foot, rear heel begins lifting. Frames 8-11: rear foot catches up close to ground, briefly narrower stance, rear toes land, rear sole rolls flat. Frames 12-15: balanced guard is restored, hip/shoulders settle gently, cloth settles, finish one tiny increment before frame 0 for a seamless loop.
Keep torso upright and nearly level, head vertical variation below 2% of body height. Short combat steps, maximum sole lift 3% of body height. Preserve readable face in every frame. Add subtle evolving garment folds at knees/elbows and small delayed movement in hair, scarf and coat tails; fabric hangs with gravity, no windstorm. Hands retain the same relaxed defensive position.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR columns by FOUR rows, 16 separate full-body sprites on TRUE transparent background. Every invisible cell is equal size. Each sprite has the same physical scale and fixed pelvis X within its cell, fixed supporting foot floor Y within each row. Keep full head, hair, cloth, hands and feet 20 pixels INSIDE every cell. Wide transparent gutters, no touching sprites, no cropping. Read left to right then top to bottom as ONE loop. Crisp limited-palette arcade pixel shading matched to the reference, outlined silhouettes, no antialiased blur, no text, labels, effects, shadows, weapons beyond identity reference, or background.
